metadata.description: Community plugins from the Agentic Engineering WhatsApp group.

plugins.name: usage-review
plugins.description: Weekly Claude Code token usage by model and effort from local transcripts, with ranked recommendations to cut tokens or raise quality.

plugins.name: agent-status
plugins.description: Live sub-agent status: a band above the prompt with one row per active agent, an /agent-status pane, and a toast when an agent ends.

plugins.name: usage-meter
plugins.description: Shows your account rate-limit windows (5h, 7d, spend) as a band above the prompt or a status line, toasts at warn and critical levels, and adds /limits.

plugins.name: context-meter
plugins.description: Context fill, last-turn tokens and session cost in the status line; a warning toast near the limit; /ctx for the breakdown.
